entities.description: A pale beige landmass with a highly irregular, jagged coastline featuring numerous inlets and peninsulas, set against a light blue background representing water. The landmass has a roughly oval shape with a wider northern section and a narrower southern tip, and the coastline is detailed with small bays and protrusions.

A pale beige landmass with a highly irregular, jagged coastline featuring numerous deep inlets and peninsulas, set against a light blue background. The landmass has a textured, paper-like appearance with subtle shading variations.

A vintage-style map of Europe featuring a textured, aged paper background in beige tones with light blue water. The landmasses are depicted in a slightly darker beige with subtle topographical shading and thin, faint lines indicating country borders. The map includes the British Isles, Scandinavia, the Iberian Peninsula, Italy, and parts of North Africa and the Middle East.
